description: Connectivity + containment associations (UN-style). Geometry lives in GeoJSON; this file is the graph.

connectivity.description: Electrical path. fromId/toId reference feature id; optional fromTerminal/toTerminal.

containment.description: Device inside structure (meter in cabinet, EMS in enclosure).

attachment.description: Device on structure (xfmr on pole, DTM on pole).

trace.downstream: from subnetwork controller (feeder head / island) along connectivity edges
trace.scope: default filter associations where subnetworkId matches selected feeder; island trace drops filter
